name: Iron & Rust
source: 2016. Marius Friedrich is a young student during day and a hacktivist at night. When he discovers the track to a top secret program on artificial intelligence, DARPA's "Thunderbird" project, and he steps on an unknown and dangerous ground, begins an adventure that will lead him to the limits of human understanding.
translation: 2016年。马吕斯·弗里德里希 (Marius Friedrich) 白天是一名年轻学生，晚上则是一名黑客行动主义者。当他发现了人工智能绝密项目（DARPA的“雷鸟”项目）的踪迹时，他踏上了未知而危险的土地，开始了一场冒险，这将引导他走向人类理解的极限。
